title: A Geometry-Aware Operator Learning Framework for Interface Problems on Varying Domains
summary: Solving Partial Differential Equation (PDE) interface problems on varying domains is a critical task in design and optimization, yet it remains computationally prohibitive for traditional solvers. Although operator learning has shown promise on fixed geometries, its potential for geometry-dependent interface problems has been largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose an extension-based neural operator framework applicable to general linear interface problems.
